env BOLERO_MODULE=off

# bolero env should default to the right places
env AppData=$HOME/windowsappdata
env home=$HOME/plan9home
bolero env BOLERO_ENV
[GOOS:aix] stdout $HOME/.config/bolero/env
[GOOS:darwin] stdout $HOME'/Library/Application Support/bolero/env'
[GOOS:freebsd] stdout $HOME/.config/bolero/env
[GOOS:linux] stdout $HOME/.config/bolero/env
[GOOS:netbsd] stdout $HOME/.config/bolero/env
[GOOS:openbsd] stdout $HOME/.config/bolero/env
[GOOS:plan9] stdout $HOME/plan9home/lib/bolero/env
[GOOS:windows] stdout $HOME\\windowsappdata\\bolero\\env

# Now override it to something writable.
env BOLERO_ENV=$WORK/envdir/bolero/env
bolero env BOLERO_ENV
stdout envdir[\\/]bolero[\\/]env

# bolero env shows all variables
bolero env
stdout GOARCH=
stdout GOOS=
stdout BOLERO_ROOT=

# bolero env ignores invalid flag in BOLERO_FLAGS environment variable
env BOLERO_FLAGS='=true'
bolero env

# checking errors
! bolero env -w
stderr 'bolero: no KEY=VALUE arguments given'
! bolero env -u
stderr 'bolero: ''bolero env -u'' requires an argument'

# bolero env -w changes default setting
env root=
[GOOS:windows] env root=c:
env BOLERO_PATH=
bolero env -w BOLERO_PATH=$root/non-exist/gopath
! stderr .+
grep BOLERO_PATH=$root/non-exist/gopath $WORK/envdir/bolero/env
bolero env BOLERO_PATH
stdout /non-exist/gopath

# bolero env -w does not override OS environment, and warns about that
env BOLERO_PATH=$root/other
bolero env -w BOLERO_PATH=$root/non-exist/gopath2
stderr 'warning: bolero env -w BOLERO_PATH=... does not override conflicting OS environment variable'
bolero env BOLERO_PATH
stdout $root/other

# but bolero env -w does do the update, and unsetting the env var exposes the change
env BOLERO_PATH=
bolero env BOLERO_PATH
stdout $root/non-exist/gopath2

# unsetting with bolero env -u does not warn about OS environment overrides,
# nor does it warn about variables that haven't been set by bolero env -w.
env BOLERO_PATH=$root/other
bolero env -u BOLERO_PATH
! stderr .+
bolero env -u BOLERO_PATH
! stderr .+

# bolero env -w rejects unknown or bad variables
! bolero env -w GOGC=off
stderr 'unknown bolero command variable GOGC'
! bolero env -w GOEXE=.bat
stderr 'GOEXE cannot be modified'
! bolero env -w BOLERO_VERSION=customversion
stderr 'BOLERO_VERSION cannot be modified'
! bolero env -w BOLERO_ENV=/env
stderr 'BOLERO_ENV can only be set using the OS environment'
! bolero env -w GODEBUG=gctrace=1
stderr 'GODEBUG can only be set using the OS environment'

# bolero env -w can set multiple variables
env CC=
bolero env CC
! stdout ^xyc$
bolero env -w GOOS=$GOOS CC=xyc
grep CC=xyc $BOLERO_ENV
# file is maintained in sorted order
grep 'CC=xyc\nGOOS=' $BOLERO_ENV
bolero env CC
stdout ^xyc$

# bolero env -u unsets effect of bolero env -w.
bolero env -u CC
bolero env CC
! stdout ^xyc$

# bolero env -w rejects double-set variables
! bolero env -w GOOS=$GOOS GOOS=$GOOS
stderr 'multiple values for key: GOOS'

# bolero env -w rejects missing variables
! bolero env -w GOOS
stderr 'arguments must be KEY=VALUE: invalid argument: GOOS'

# bolero env -w rejects invalid BOLERO_MODULE values, as otherwise cmd/go would break
! bolero env -w BOLERO_MODULE=badvalue
stderr 'invalid BOLERO_MODULE value "badvalue"'

# bolero env -w rejects invalid BOLERO_PATH values
! bolero env -w BOLERO_PATH=~/go
stderr 'BOLERO_PATH entry cannot start with shell metacharacter'

! bolero env -w BOLERO_PATH=./go
stderr 'BOLERO_PATH entry is relative; must be absolute path'

# bolero env -w rejects invalid BOLERO_TMPDIR values
! bolero env -w BOLERO_TMPDIR=x
stderr 'bolero: BOLERO_TMPDIR must be an absolute path'

# bolero env -w should accept absolute BOLERO_TMPDIR value
# and should not create it
[GOOS:windows] bolero env -w BOLERO_TMPDIR=$WORK\x\y\z
[!GOOS:windows] bolero env -w BOLERO_TMPDIR=$WORK/x/y/z
! exists $WORK/x/y/z
# we should be able to clear an env
bolero env -u BOLERO_TMPDIR
bolero env BOLERO_TMPDIR
stdout ^$

[GOOS:windows] bolero env -w BOLERO_TMPDIR=$WORK\x\y\z
[!GOOS:windows] bolero env -w BOLERO_TMPDIR=$WORK/x/y/z
bolero env -w BOLERO_TMPDIR=
bolero env BOLERO_TMPDIR
stdout ^$

# bolero env -w rejects relative CC values
[!GOOS:windows] bolero env -w CC=/usr/bin/clang
bolero env -w CC=clang
[!GOOS:windows] ! bolero env -w CC=./clang
[!GOOS:windows] ! bolero env -w CC=bin/clang
[!GOOS:windows] stderr 'bolero: CC entry is relative; must be absolute path'

[GOOS:windows] bolero env -w CC=$WORK\bin\clang
[GOOS:windows] ! bolero env -w CC=.\clang
[GOOS:windows] ! bolero env -w CC=bin\clang
[GOOS:windows] stderr 'bolero: CC entry is relative; must be absolute path'

# bolero env -w rejects relative CXX values
[!GOOS:windows] bolero env -w CC=/usr/bin/cpp
bolero env -w CXX=cpp
[!GOOS:windows] ! bolero env -w CXX=./cpp
[!GOOS:windows] ! bolero env -w CXX=bin/cpp
[!GOOS:windows] stderr 'bolero: CXX entry is relative; must be absolute path'

[GOOS:windows] bolero env -w CXX=$WORK\bin\cpp
[GOOS:windows] ! bolero env -w CXX=.\cpp
[GOOS:windows] ! bolero env -w CXX=bin\cpp
[GOOS:windows] stderr 'bolero: CXX entry is relative; must be absolute path'

# bolero env -w/-u checks validity of GOOS/ARCH combinations
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
# check -w doesn't allow invalid GOOS
! bolero env -w GOOS=linuxx
stderr 'unsupported GOOS/GOARCH pair linuxx'
# check -w doesn't allow invalid GOARCH
! bolero env -w GOARCH=amd644
stderr 'unsupported GOOS/GOARCH.*/amd644$'
# check -w doesn't allow invalid GOOS with valid GOARCH
! bolero env -w GOOS=linuxx GOARCH=amd64
stderr 'unsupported GOOS/GOARCH pair linuxx'
# check a valid GOOS and GOARCH values but an incompatible combinations
! bolero env -w GOOS=android GOARCH=s390x
stderr 'unsupported GOOS/GOARCH pair android/s390x'
# check that -u considers explicit envs
bolero env -w GOOS=linux GOARCH=mips
env GOOS=windows
! bolero env -u GOOS
stderr 'unsupported GOOS/GOARCH.*windows/mips$'
env GOOS=

# bolero env -w should reject relative paths in BOLERO_MODCACHE environment.
! bolero env -w BOLERO_MODCACHE=~/test
stderr 'bolero: BOLERO_MODCACHE entry is relative; must be absolute path: "~/test"'
! bolero env -w BOLERO_MODCACHE=./test
stderr 'bolero: BOLERO_MODCACHE entry is relative; must be absolute path: "./test"'

# bolero env -w checks validity of GOEXPERIMENT
env GOEXPERIMENT=
! bolero env -w GOEXPERIMENT=badexp
stderr 'unknown GOEXPERIMENT badexp'
bolero env -w GOEXPERIMENT=fieldtrack

# bolero env -w and bolero env -u work on unknown fields already in the go/env file
cp bad.env $BOLERO_ENV
bolero env BOLERO_ENV
cat $BOLERO_ENV
bolero env
! stdout UNKNOWN
bolero env UNKNOWN
stdout yes
bolero env -w UNKNOWN=maybe
bolero env UNKNOWN
stdout maybe
bolero env -u UNKNOWN
bolero env UNKNOWN
! stdout . # gone

-- bad.env --
UNKNOWN=yes
